body.name: Fcmp
body.def: For \(z\in\{\mathrm{OVS},\mathrm{const}\}\), \(F_z(\mu)\) is the explicit moment reconstruction in Definition \(\ref{def:gap-one-step}\); at the true moment it equals \(\operatorname{Var}_P\{b_z(P)'\Psi_P\}-V_{\mathrm{OVS}}\), with \(b_z(P)\) the declared law-dependent comparator rule.
